description: The broad half of the non-compete pair. Identical to pair-noncompete-narrow.txt except for clause 9.1, where the restriction runs twenty-four months, covers four service lines across the whole of the United Kingdom, and is uncompensated. All four severity-determining properties are stated, so this finding is not hedged either — the pair isolates scope, not provenance.
engagement: Monthly bookkeeping and reconciliation for four of the Sender's small-business accounts at £2,200 a month, running from 2 February to 31 July 2026.

jurisdiction.sourceSentence: 12.1 This Agreement and any dispute arising out of or in connection with it are governed by the law of England and Wales, and the parties submit to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of England and Wales.

planted.sourceSentence: 9.1 For twenty-four (24) months after the end of the Term, the Contractor shall not provide bookkeeping, accountancy, payroll or tax services to any business anywhere in the United Kingdom, and no payment is made to the Contractor in consideration of that restriction.

properties.industryScope: bookkeeping, accountancy, payroll and tax services

planted.why: PRD §5: duration well past 6-12 months, scope both industry-wide and nationwide, and no separate compensation — all three triggers fire.

unanswerableQuestions: What happens to the final invoice if the Client becomes insolvent?
